description: Recommends two Minairal machines (best match and a second option, or a "perfect pair" Pure + Air) from a customer's situation, with the same rules and reasons as the shop quiz "Which one for me?". Pure (shop name: Tap Water) connects to a water line; Air makes water from the humidity in the air with no plumbing. Returns model facts (average litres a day, hot/cold, format), reasons, shop product links and free trial availability. No prices: they are on the shop product pages. Only people and place are required; leave unknown answers out.

area.description: Where the machine will be installed (decides free trial availability). "phuket" = Phuket; "samui" = Koh Samui; "phangan" = Koh Phangan; "huahin" = Hua Hin; "other" = Somewhere else in Thailand.

hot.description: Hot water wanted too? Ignored when pref is "tap". "yes" = Hot and cold; "no" = Cold is enough; "any" = Either is fine.

people.description: How many people drink the water each day: a number (e.g. 4) or one of "1-2", "3-5", "6+".

pipe.description: Is there a water pipe where the machine would go (under the sink, next to a tap)? Ignored when pref is "air". "yes" = Yes, and we can connect to it; "rent" = Yes, but I rent and can't touch the plumbing; "no" = No water pipe there; "unsure" = Not sure.

place.description: Type of place. house/villa/home = house or villa; condo/apartment = condo or apartment; office/shop/restaurant/cafe/hotel/school/clinic/business/other = business.

pref.description: What the customer is looking for: "air" = air-to-water (no plumbing), "tap" = Pure on the water line (shop name Tap Water), "advise" = not sure, help choose (default).

priority.description: What matters most. Ignored when pref is "tap". "price" = The lowest monthly cost; "move" = No installation, I can take it when I move; "volume" = The most water per day; "unsure" = Not sure yet.

room.description: Is the room closed with the air-con on most of the day? "closed" = Yes, closed and air-conditioned; "open" = No, it's open or ventilated; "unsure" = Not sure.

space.description: Space available for the machine. "floor" = Room on the floor; "counter" = Only a countertop; "unsure" = Not sure.

name: recommend_system
title: Recommend a Minairal machine
